comments.body:
Durability: 150
Vert Sail: +8
Horz Sail: +4
Turn: +2
Armour: -2
Sailing Cost: 1
Equipment Effect: Turning Technique
Req. Optional Ship Skill: Emergency Acceleration

As far as i can tell "Turning Technique" does not raises turning rate overall but gives you something like a turning angle. With it i can turn about 15° (give or take), without slowing down completly. After that it looks like turning with EA on looks like, aka REALY slow.

How Earplugs help with turning speed? Well, your guess is a good as mine.
